commands.cmd:
TAG_COMMIT=95f8322ee1dcda7ceace7b1c4f6c9915b36d748f
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
tag=$(timeout 30 git ls-remote https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi 'refs/tags/0.141.1' 'refs/tags/0.141.1^{}' | awk '{print $1}' | tail -1)
timeout 180 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch 0.141.1 https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "FASTAPI_RELEASE_FAIL: clone of fastapi 0.141.1 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
python3 - "$D/src" "$tag" "$head" "$TAG_COMMIT" <<'PY'
import glob, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, re, sys, tomllib, urllib.request, zipfile
src, tag, head, expected = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
stack = [x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id'] == 'fastapi']
winners = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'fastapi'})
found = re.search(r'^__version__ = "([^"]+)"', (src / 'fastapi/__init__.py').read_text(), re.M)
version = found.group(1) if found else None
lock = tomllib.load(open('blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/uv.lock', 'rb'))
locked = {p['name']: p for p in lock['package']}['fastapi']
wheel = locked['wheels'][0]
want = wheel['hash'].removeprefix('sha256:')
data = urllib.request.urlopen(wheel['url'], timeout=30).read()
got = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
wheel_files = sorted(n for n in archive.namelist() if n.startswith('fastapi/') and not n.endswith('/'))
tag_files = sorted(p.relative_to(src).as_posix() for p in (src / 'fastapi').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
identical = bool(wheel_files) and wheel_files == tag_files and all(archive.read(n) == (src / n).read_bytes() for n in wheel_files)
metadata = [n for n in archive.namelist() if n.endswith('.dist-info/METADATA')]
found = re.search(r'^Version: (\S+)', archive.read(metadata[0]).decode(), re.M) if len(metadata) == 1 else None
meta_version = found.group(1) if found else None
ok = (stack == ['0.141.1'] and winners == ['0.141.1'] and tag == head == expected and version == '0.141.1'
      and locked['version'] == '0.141.1' and want == got and meta_version == '0.141.1' and identical)
print('FASTAPI_RELEASE_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| winner pin', winners, 'stack', stack, '| fastapi/fastapi tag 0.141.1 resolves to commit', tag, '(clone HEAD equal:', head == tag, ') | tag __version__', version, '| PyPI wheel sha256 == application-delivery uv.lock:', want == got, '| wheel METADATA Version', meta_version, '| wheel fastapi/ files', len(wheel_files), 'byte-identical to the tag checkout:', identical)
print('wheel', wheel['url'].rsplit('/', 1)[-1], 'sha256', got, '| tag checkout fastapi/ files', len(tag_files))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

commands.cmd:
TAG_COMMIT=95f8322ee1dcda7ceace7b1c4f6c9915b36d748f
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$D/tmp" || exit 1
timeout 180 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch 0.141.1 https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: clone of fastapi 0.141.1 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$head" = "$TAG_COMMIT" ] || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: checkout $head is not $TAG_COMMIT"; exit 1; }
cd "$D/src" || exit 1
export TMPDIR="$D/tmp" UV_CACHE_DIR="$D/uv-cache" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$D/venv" UV_PYTHON=3.13 UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never
timeout 600 uv sync --locked --no-dev --group tests --extra all > "$D/sync.log" 2>&1 || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: uv sync --locked --no-dev --group tests --extra all failed"; tail -20 "$D/sync.log"; exit 1; }
env_info=$(uv run --no-sync python -c "import sys, fastapi, pytest, starlette, pydantic; print(fastapi.__version__, fastapi.__file__, pytest.__version__, starlette.__version__, pydantic.VERSION, sys.version.split()[0])") || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: the test environment did not start"; exit 1; }
timeout 1200 uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test.sh -rfEsx > "$D/pytest.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
git diff --quiet HEAD
tracked_changed=$?
uv_version=$(uv --version)
python3 - "$D" "$rc" "$tracked_changed" "$env_info" "$uv_version" "$head" <<'PY'
import collections, re, sys
d, rc, changed, env_info, uv_version, head = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6]
lines = open(d + '/pytest.log').read().splitlines()
summary = [line for line in lines if re.match(r'^=+ .* in [0-9.]+s', line)]
last = summary[-1].strip('= ') if summary else 'no summary'
counts = {k: int(n) for n, k in re.findall(r'(\d+) (passed|failed|errors?|skipped|xfailed|xpassed)', last)}
configfile = [line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in lines if line.startswith('configfile:')]
workers = [line.strip() for line in lines if re.match(r'^\d+ workers \[\d+ items\]$', line.strip())]
script = [line[2:].strip() for line in lines if line.startswith('+ pytest ')]
fastapi_version, fastapi_file, pytest_version, starlette_version, pydantic_version, python_version = env_info.split()
from_checkout = fastapi_file == d + '/src/fastapi/__init__.py'
reasons = collections.Counter()
skips = collections.Counter()
for line in lines:
    found = re.match(r'^SKIPPED \[(\d+)\] [^:]+(?::\d+)?: (.*)$', line)
    if found:
        number, reason = int(found.group(1)), found.group(2)
        reasons[reason] += number
        skips[next((k for k in ('codspeed', 'ujson', 'orjson', 'python3.14') if k in reason), reason[:40])] += number
xfails = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('XFAIL ')]
ok = (rc == 0 and bool(summary) and counts.get('passed', 0) >= 3000 and counts.get('failed', 0) == 0
      and counts.get('error', 0) == 0 and counts.get('errors', 0) == 0 and counts.get('xpassed', 0) == 0
      and configfile == ['pyproject.toml'] and changed == 0 and from_checkout and fastapi_version == '0.141.1'
      and sum(skips.values()) == counts.get('skipped', 0)
      and script == ['pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/ -rfEsx'])
print('FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_TESTS_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| scripts/test.sh ran', script[0] if len(script) == 1 else script, ': exit', rc, '|', last, '| configfile', configfile, '| tracked files unchanged:', changed == 0, '| fastapi', fastapi_version, 'from the checkout:', from_checkout, '| Python', python_version, 'pytest', pytest_version)
print('skips:', dict(skips), '| xfail', len(xfails), '| uv', uv_version.split()[1] if len(uv_version.split()) > 1 else uv_version)
print(workers[0] if workers else 'no worker line', '| checkout', head, '|', uv_version, '| starlette', starlette_version, 'pydantic', pydantic_version, '| skip reasons as printed:', dict(reasons))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

TAG_COMMIT=95f8322ee1dcda7ceace7b1c4f6c9915b36d748f
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
SPID=
left=
kill_needed=
stop_server() {
  [ -n "$SPID" ] || return 0
  /bin/kill -TERM -- "-$SPID" 2>/dev/null
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 50 ] && pgrep -g "$SPID" > /dev/null 2>&1; do n=$((n + 1)); sleep 0.1; done
  kill_needed=0
  if pgrep -g "$SPID" > /dev/null 2>&1; then kill_needed=1; /bin/kill -KILL -- "-$SPID" 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.2; fi
  if pgrep -g "$SPID" > /dev/null 2>&1; then left=1; else left=0; fi
  SPID=
}
trap 'stop_server; rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$D/tmp" "$D/home" || exit 1
timeout 180 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch 0.141.1 https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_EXAMPLE_FAIL: clone of fastapi 0.141.1 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$head" = "$TAG_COMMIT" ] || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_EXAMPLE_FAIL: checkout $head is not $TAG_COMMIT"; exit 1; }
cd "$D/src" || exit 1
export TMPDIR="$D/tmp" UV_CACHE_DIR="$D/uv-cache" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$D/venv" UV_PYTHON=3.13 UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never
timeout 600 uv sync --locked --no-dev --group tests --extra all > "$D/sync.log" 2>&1 || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_EXAMPLE_FAIL: uv sync --locked --no-dev --group tests --extra all failed"; tail -20 "$D/sync.log"; exit 1; }
PORT=$("$D/venv/bin/python" -c "import socket
s = socket.socket()
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
print(s.getsockname()[1])
s.close()") || exit 1
HOME="$D/home" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 setsid "$D/venv/bin/fastapi" run docs_src/first_steps/tutorial001_py310.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" > "$D/server.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
SPID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SPID" | tr -d ' ')
[ "$PGID" = "$SPID" ] || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_EXAMPLE_FAIL: server pid $SPID is not its own process group leader (pgid $PGID)"; /bin/kill -TERM "$SPID" 2>/dev/null; SPID=; exit 1; }
i=0
ready=0
while [ "$i" -lt 120 ]; do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 3 -o "$D/root.json" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.5
done
[ "$ready" = "1" ] || { echo "FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_EXAMPLE_FAIL: server did not become ready"; tail -20 "$D/server.log"; exit 1; }
code_missing=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/missing.json" -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/no-such-path")
code_docs=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/docs")
code_schema=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/openapi.json" -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/openapi.json")
owned=$SPID
stop_server
if curl -fsS --max-time 1 -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" 2>/dev/null; then port_open=1; else port_open=0; fi
python3 - "$D" "$code_missing" "$code_docs" "$code_schema" "$left" "$port_open" "$owned" "$kill_needed" "$PORT" <<'PY'
import json, sys
d, code_missing, code_docs, code_schema, left, port_open, owned, kill_needed, port = sys.argv[1:10]
root = json.load(open(d + '/root.json'))
missing = json.load(open(d + '/missing.json'))
schema = json.load(open(d + '/openapi.json')) if code_schema == '200' else {}
documented = '{"message": "Hello World"}' in open('docs/en/docs/tutorial/first-steps.md').read()
log = open(d + '/server.log').read()
checks = {
    'GET / returns the documented {"message": "Hello World"}': documented and root == {'message': 'Hello World'},
    'GET /no-such-path -> 404 {"detail": "Not Found"}': code_missing == '404' and missing == {'detail': 'Not Found'},
    'GET /docs -> 200': code_docs == '200',
    'GET /openapi.json lists exactly the path /': code_schema == '200' and sorted(schema.get('paths', {})) == ['/'],
    'server log names Uvicorn on the loopback port': f'Uvicorn running on http://127.0.0.1:{port}' in log,
    'owned process group empty after signalling only it': left == '0',
    'port no longer accepts connections': port_open == '0',
}
failed = [name for name, passed in checks.items() if not passed]
print('FASTAPI_UPSTREAM_EXAMPLE_' + ('OK' if not failed else 'FAIL'), '| fastapi run docs_src/first_steps/tutorial001_py310.py --host 127.0.0.1 (the upstream first-steps example):', len(checks) - len(failed), 'of', len(checks), 'checks pass | GET / ->', root, '| unknown path', code_missing, missing, '| /docs', code_docs, '| stopped only its own process group (pgid == pid ' + owned + '): processes left', left, '(KILL needed:', kill_needed + ') | failed:', failed)
for name, passed in checks.items():
    print('PASS' if passed else 'FAIL', '-', name)
sys.exit(0 if not failed else 1)
PY
